## Summary / 变更说明

Describe what changed and why. / 说明改动内容和原因。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run` when configuration changed / 配置变更时执行
- [ ] Relevant manual flow tested / 已验证相关手动流程

## Safety / 安全检查

- [ ] No secrets, customer data, generated builds, or local Cloudflare state / 不包含密钥、客户数据、构建产物或本地 Cloudflare 状态
- [ ] Tenant, billing, replay, and refund boundaries remain correct / 多租户、计费、重放和退款边界保持正确
- [ ] English and Chinese copy/docs are synchronized / 中英文文案和文档保持同步

## Screenshots / 截图

Add screenshots for user-visible UI changes. / 用户可见的界面改动请附截图。
